# Codex Rate Monitor v0.2.1

## Fixed

- The tray tooltip no longer cuts text mid-word. Windows caps tray tooltips at
  63 characters, which truncated the reset-credit line to a broken fragment
  ("earlies"). The English tray strings are now shorter, and any overflow is
  trimmed at a line boundary instead of inside a word.

## Changed

- Update notifications are now limited to a red-dot badge on the tray icon
  (plus the "Check for updates" context menu entry). The floating overlay and
  the tray tooltip stay purely about usage, in both attach and desktop modes.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/D1NOOO/codex-usage-monitor/compare/v0.2.0...v0.2.1
